requiredText: Opt  Date      Time      Type  User        Job        Message
functionKeys: F3=Exit   F5=Refresh   F7=Page up   F8=Page down   F12=Cancel
notes: Stock IBM DSPSECAUD is a read-only summary of QAUDCTL/QAUDLVL. Lab DSPSECAUD_AF adds an AF entry subfile with option 5=Display entry details — training extension not on stock panel. GO SECTOOLS option 11 also invokes DSPSECAUD.
auditNotes: Shows QAUDCTL/QAUDLVL effective policy plus recent AF summary. CHGSECAUD consolidates setup steps from IBM security auditing guide.
